physical.cover-material: steel door with ABS ends and knobs

configs.description: The manager as Panduit ships PR2VSD06, its door fitted.
configs.name: base

configs.description: The same manager with its door taken off, the finger columns and the channel open to lay a cable in. The door comes with the manager, so this is an illustration and not a device type.
configs.name: door-off

gaps.note: the PR2VSD is "dual-sided with one door": the product page and the drawing's note 4 say one door and no document says which face it closes. It is drawn on the front.
gaps.wanted: a render of the PR2VSD06 with its door fitted

gaps.note: the bulletin's charts and Panduit's calculator state capacities for the PR2VD06 and PR2VFD06 and not for the PR2VSD06, so none is stated.
gaps.wanted: a capacity row for the PR2VSD06

gaps.note: the door is "dual-hinging" and opens to the left or the right on hinge pins; no view draws a hinge, and the door is drawn as one fitted plate that is either on or off.
gaps.wanted: a drawing or a close render of a door's hinge and latch

gaps.note: the front view draws each finger as a loop; it is built as a solid block 30 across and 33 high, and its length (260 front, 175 rear) is estimated from the calculator's channel areas.
gaps.wanted: a section through a finger and the backbone

gaps.note: the drawing's "free standing base", the integrated door brackets and the stand-off from a rack are not drawn or dimensioned.
gaps.wanted: a drawing of the base and its fixing to a rack
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - the material, colour, standards and what is in the box are the PR2VSD06 product page and the specification sheet (RKSP172); the materials are the drawing's.

bottom.note: estimated - the top view again: the two ends of the manager are alike.

capacity.note: no Panduit document states a capacity for the PR2VSD06: the bulletin's charts and the calculator list the PR2VD and PR2VFD parts of the same width and not the PR2VSD. It is left out (`gaps:`); the PR2VD06's figures are not carried over.

chassis.note: drawing - 152.4 x 2130.4 x 526.4, covers fitted: the PR2VSD table's A 6.00 in [152.4], B 83.88 in [2130.4] and C [526.4] for the PR2VSD06 (the table prints 20.2 in beside the 526.4 mm, and 20.7 in for the same mm on the PR2VD sheet: the millimetres are taken). The Space-Saving bulletin states 6.0 x 84.0 x 20.6 in (152 x 2130 x 523 mm).

color.note: estimated - "The manager is black" on the product page. Every image Panduit publishes of the part is a render; the door is drawn a shade lighter than the backbone.

depth.note: estimated - the 526.4 is overall. It is drawn as a 303 front channel, a 20.4 backbone and a 203 rear channel (see pr2vd08): the PR2VSD drawing shares the PR2VD's plan view.

front.note: drawing - the front with the door fitted: the door, and under it the backbone with 45 fingers a side in three sections of 15 and the four holes. The `duct` guide is the channel between the finger columns, run down the height: 123.2 across, the 6 in less the 29.2 the calculator's front area per inch of width (9.3 sq in, from the PR2VD06 to PR2VD12) leaves, ESTIMATED.

guides.note: estimated - each duct is the channel between the two finger columns of its face, run down the height (`run: y`), with the rack unit's 44.45 pitch and the 11.45 left between 33 mm fingers.

left.note: estimated - no side view of the manager without its door is dimensioned: the backbone, and the two finger zones along it, built from the plan view and the finger columns' extent.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DOCUMENTS, read as the PR2VD08's are (see pr2vd08): the PR2VSD** customer drawing (PDF 14V455MW-DC), the PR2VD** drawing (14V455LV-DC) whose views it repeats, the PatchRunner 2 Vertical Cable Managers specification sheet RKSP172, the product page and the Space-Saving bulletin RKCB46 (which lists the part's width only). THE FIGURES THE TABLE GIVES ARE `drawing`; EVERYTHING READ OFF THE PICTURES (the split of the depth between the channels, the finger's size, the holes' places) IS ESTIMATED and said so in the part that carries it.

mount.note: drawing - `rack-side`, as the FS vertical ducts and the PR2VD08: the PR2VSD drawing (Panduit 14V455MW-DC) is the PR2VD drawing's manager with one door. It occupies no rack unit; `ru: 45` is the height it runs beside (the 83.88 in of the table is a 7 ft, 45 RU manager). Which side of the rack is a lab placement to say (docs/vertical-cable-managers-design.md).

rear.note: estimated - the rear with no door: the PR2VSD drawing is "front and rear fingers" and the part includes one door (see `gaps:` for which face has it). The `duct` is 111.2 across, the 6 in less the 41.2 that the calculator's rear area per inch of width (6.23 sq in) leaves, ESTIMATED.

right.note: estimated - the left view turned round.

shell.note: drawing - TWO HOLLOW CHANNELS BACK TO BACK, NOT A BOX (see pr2vd08): the backbone as a well 303 deep on the front view and 203 deep on the rear view, each with its fingers; the front has the door; both floors open at the four 3.0 in holes.

thickness.note: estimated - no Panduit document states the steel's gauge. 1.5 is a sheet of this kind; the parts carry their own thicknesses.

top.note: estimated - the plan, rear at y=0: the rear fingers, the backbone and the front fingers, built from the plan view of the drawing and the finger lengths above.

weight.note: drawing - 18.7 kg [41.19 lb], the manager and door unpacked, the weight column of the PR2VSD table; 19.6 kg [43.19 lb] shipped.
